description: The PC's quick actions: weapon_keys are the weapons of the number keys 1..0 and '-' in order (the mouse wheel walks the same list), weapon_cycle the order of the cycle bind (acquisition order). quick_heal: no heal at or over full_health; the first tier whose condition holds (below_health: health under it; missing_at_most: at most that much under full) spends the first owned item of its order, the next tiers are not tried. report: the items the toast after a heal names and counts. Items by name; a mod patches this file like any data file.

tiers.description: critical: the strongest first (the ampoule also refills the regeneration)
light: a drink fills it with no waste
moderate: the first aid kit is the tight fit
